theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h : (P : Set (Set S)).Intersecting := by
    simpa only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Finset.mem_coe] using hPP
  have hc := h.is_max_iff_card_eq.mp (by
    intro Q hQ hPQ
    refine Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ fun A hA => ?_
    by_contra hn
    exact hPS ⟨A, hn, fun B hB he =>
      hQ hA (hPQ hB) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr he)⟩)
  rw [Fintype.card_set] at hc
  have hp := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
  have he : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by omega
  rw [← he, pow_succ] at hc
  omega
